note: NOTE: This template is a working structure, not a final specification — follow it to the best of your ability and report any areas or commands that need improvement after use.
shared: Match the attached reference's art style, design, materials, palette and proportions exactly; with no reference, use felt-plush storybook character art for 2D animation. Plain transparent background; if transparency is unavailable, use one perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) with no gradient, shading or glow anywhere on it, and no magenta in the character. No text, labels, frames, shadows or props. Nothing touches a cell or canvas edge. Clean solid silhouette edge with no loose fibres or specks. Every drawing of the character keeps the same design, palette, proportions and scale.
stance: Animation-ready stance: standing upright, feet planted shoulder-width apart with a clear gap of background between the legs from the crotch to the floor, arms held slightly away from the body (about 20 degrees) with a clear gap between each arm and the body, hands open, head level. Every limb is fully visible and not overlapping another limb.

new.label: New character
new.layout: One full-body front view, centred horizontally, about 1300 px tall, feet on a baseline at y = 1440.

image.label: Redraw for animation
image.layout: Redraw the attached character exactly (same design, colours, clothing, materials) as one full-body front view, centred horizontally, about 1300 px tall, feet on a baseline at y = 1440.

sheet.label: Turnaround sheet
sheet.layout: Four views of the attached character in one row of four equal cells (384 x 1024 px each), left to right: front, right profile (nose pointing right), back, left profile (nose pointing left). Each figure about 880 px tall, feet on one shared baseline at y = 960, same scale in every cell.

poses.label: Pose sheet
poses.layout: Six poses of the attached character in a grid of 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells (512 x 512 px each), left to right then top to bottom: idle, walk (mid-stride, side view facing right), jump (in the air), wave (right hand raised), talk (mouth open, one hand gesturing), cheer (both arms up). Each figure about 440 px tall, feet on the cell baseline at 490 px from the cell top (the jump pose floats above it), same scale in every cell.

actions.label: Action frames
actions.layout: {frames} consecutive animation frames of the attached character performing {action}, {view}, in a grid of 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells (384 x 512 px each), read left to right then top to bottom: {keys}. Each figure about 440 px tall, the planted foot on the cell baseline at 490 px from the cell top, same scale and same horizontal centre in every cell so the frames play in place as a sprite cycle, and the last frame leads back into the first when the action loops.

walk.keys: contact (right foot forward), down, passing, up, contact (left foot forward), down, passing, up

run.keys: contact, down, push-off, flight, contact (other foot), down, push-off, flight

jump.keys: stand, anticipation crouch, take-off, rise, apex, fall, landing squash, recover

wave.keys: rest, arm rising, hand up open, wave left, wave right, wave left, wave right, arm lowering

turn.keys: front, three-quarter right, right profile, three-quarter back right, back, three-quarter back left, left profile, three-quarter left

sing.keys: rest; small inhale with shoulders rising; mouth opening; head tilting back on the high note; arm sweeping out; arm at full extension; arm returning; settle back toward rest

layers.label: Overlapping layers
layers.layout: The attached character separated into cut-out animation parts, in a grid of 3 columns x 3 rows of equal cells (512 x 512 px each), left to right then top to bottom: head; torso with no limbs; near upper arm; near forearm with hand; far upper arm; far forearm with hand; near leg with foot; far leg with foot; empty cell. Each part is drawn whole, including everything a neighbouring part would hide in the original image: invent the hidden surface so nothing is missing underneath. Every part continues past each joint and ends in a full round cap in its own material, about 90 px across, so that overlapping neighbours can rotate without showing a gap. Limbs hang straight down with the upper joint cap centred at x=256, y=90 of the cell. The head's neck cap is centred at x=256, y=440. The torso keeps the original proportions. Same scale in every cell, nothing touches a cell edge.

parts_chroma.label: Chroma-green parts sheet (#00FF00)
parts_chroma.layout: Exploded 2D puppet disassembly parts sheet of the attached character on a perfectly flat solid chroma-green (#00FF00) background, arranged in 6 non-overlapping regions with generous 40 px green margins between every piece: top-centre = head (complete with neck joint cap); middle-centre = torso body (with no arms or legs attached); middle-left = left arm with hand (ending in a rounded shoulder joint cap); middle-right = right arm with hand (ending in a rounded shoulder joint cap); bottom-left = left leg with foot (ending in a rounded hip joint cap); bottom-right = right leg with foot (ending in a rounded hip joint cap). Every part is drawn whole with rounded overlap caps at each joint so limbs rotate cleanly without gaps.
parts_chroma.shared_override: Match the attached reference's art style, design, materials, palette and proportions exactly. Use ONE perfectly flat solid pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background with no gradient, vignette, shadow or floor line anywhere, and no #00FF00 green inside the character parts. No text, labels, callout lines, frames or props. Nothing touches another part or the canvas edge.

poses_2x2.label: 2x2 Moppet pose sheet (4 poses)
poses_2x2.layout: Four full-body poses of the attached character in a 2 columns x 2 rows grid of equal cells (512 x 512 px each), read left to right then top to bottom: (1) top-left = idle rest stance facing front 3/4; (2) top-right = talk_sing with mouth open singing and expressive hands; (3) bottom-left = walk_hop mid-stride joyful bounce; (4) bottom-right = expressive celebration wave with both arms raised. Each figure about 430 px tall, feet planted on the cell baseline at 475 px from the cell top, identical scale and proportions in all 4 quadrants, with clear margin around each quadrant.

moppet.label: Moppet Maker pack (character + chroma parts + 2x2 poses)
moppet.layout: Three-part Workshop Moppet character bundle (1: full-body front 3/4 character cutout; 2: exploded #00FF00 chroma-green parts sheet; 3: 2x2 four-pose sheet) drawn sequentially with reference chaining and automatically ingested into views/front/drawing.png, views/front/parts_sheet.png, poses/, and character.svg.

storyboard_hero.label: Storyboard hero frame
storyboard_hero.layout: Wide 3:2 cinematic storyboard hero frame: {prompt}. Clear staging, readable foreground silhouette, storybook lighting.

storyboard_sketch.label: Storyboard beat sketch
storyboard_sketch.layout: Square storyboard beat sketch: {prompt}. Expressive gesture, clear camera framing.
